create_multihot_converter: create a Multihot instance with uniform or pareto distribution to convert 1-hot sparse features to multi-hot
convert_batch_to_multi_hot: convert a torchrec Batch with 1-hot sparse features into a multi-hot Batch using convert_to_multi_hot
save_frequency_stats: save pre-hash and post-hash frequency statistics as numpy files using save_freqs_stats
pause_stats_collection: pause frequency stats collection during validation by calling pause_stats_collection_during_val_and_test with a model
create_restartable_map: create a RestartableMap iterator that applies a function to each element of a source iterable
